es: Matizar afirmaciones académicas con verbos, modales y expresiones de cautela (may indicate, it could be argued, to a certain extent, there is limited evidence) sin exagerar lo que permiten los datos.

vocabulary.es: exagerar, afirmar más de lo que permiten los datos
en general, en su mayor parte

teaching.en: The findings may indicate that short naps improve memory, although they are hardly conclusive, since only forty students took part.
teaching.es: Los resultados podrían indicar que las siestas cortas mejoran la memoria, aunque apenas son concluyentes, ya que solo participaron cuarenta estudiantes.
teaching.explanationEs: May indicate apunta a una relación sin afirmarla. Conclusive describe una prueba que cierra la cuestión; aquí no lo es.
segments: The findings may indicate that short naps improve memory, although
they are hardly conclusive, since only forty students took part.
teaching.audioText: The findings may indicate that short naps improve memory, although they are hardly conclusive, since only forty students took part.

teaching.en: It could be argued that homework has a limited effect on learning, particularly when students already study a great deal.
teaching.es: Podría sostenerse que los deberes tienen un efecto limitado en el aprendizaje, sobre todo cuando los estudiantes ya estudian mucho.
teaching.explanationEs: It could be argued that presenta una tesis como discutible. Limited reduce el alcance: el efecto existe, pero es escaso.
segments: It could be argued that homework has a limited effect
on learning, particularly when students already study a great deal.
teaching.audioText: It could be argued that homework has a limited effect on learning, particularly when students already study a great deal.

teaching.en: To a certain extent, online classes help students who work, but the benefit appears to depend on how well they organise their time.
teaching.es: En cierta medida, las clases en línea ayudan a los estudiantes que trabajan, pero el beneficio parece depender de lo bien que organicen su tiempo.
teaching.explanationEs: To a certain extent limita el alcance; appear to + verbo base presenta algo como una apariencia, no como un hecho.
segments: To a certain extent, online classes help students who work, but the
benefit appears to depend on how well they organise their time.
teaching.audioText: To a certain extent, online classes help students who work, but the benefit appears to depend on how well they organise their time.

teaching.en: The results suggest that most students prefer quiet places, and by and large this matches what earlier surveys have shown.
teaching.es: Los resultados sugieren que la mayoría de los estudiantes prefiere lugares tranquilos, y en general esto coincide con lo que mostraron encuestas anteriores.
teaching.explanationEs: Suggest that apunta en una dirección; by and large generaliza sin excluir excepciones.
segments: The results suggest that most students prefer quiet places, and
by and large this matches what earlier surveys have shown.
teaching.audioText: The results suggest that most students prefer quiet places, and by and large this matches what earlier surveys have shown.

teaching.en: Teenagers tend to sleep later than adults, which is largely due to biology, although habits also play a part.
teaching.es: Los adolescentes suelen dormir más tarde que los adultos, lo cual se debe en gran parte a la biología, aunque los hábitos también influyen.
teaching.explanationEs: Tend to + verbo base expresa una tendencia, no una regla; largely indica que hay otras causas menores.
segments: Teenagers tend to sleep later than adults, which is largely
due to biology, although habits also play a part.
teaching.audioText: Teenagers tend to sleep later than adults, which is largely due to biology, although habits also play a part.

teaching.en: Saying that sleep is the only cause of good grades would overstate the case, because a significant difference in scores is not proof, and memory is merely likely to improve.
teaching.es: Decir que el sueño es la única causa de las buenas notas sería exagerar, porque una diferencia significativa en las notas no es una prueba y la memoria solo es probable que mejore.
teaching.explanationEs: Overstate the case es afirmar más de lo que permiten los datos; likely to + verbo base expresa probabilidad, no certeza.
segments: Saying that sleep is the only cause of good grades would overstate the case, because
a significant difference in scores is not proof, and memory is merely likely to improve.

prompt.es: Elige la versión cautelosa de esta afirmación exagerada.

choices.text: Short naps clearly improve memory in most of the students we studied.
The findings suggest that short naps may improve memory in some students.
Perhaps short naps might possibly improve the memory of some students.

feedback.es: Combina un verbo (suggest), un modal (may) y una limitación (some); la segunda exagera y la tercera apila matices hasta volverse confusa.

hint.es: Busca una sola idea matizada con un verbo y un modal, sin apilar recursos.

origin.text: Overstated claim: «Short naps improve memory in every student.» The study included only forty students.

prompt.es: Completa: «Los adolescentes suelen dormir más tarde que los adultos.»

feedback.es: Tend to + verbo base expresa una tendencia general, con excepciones posibles.

hint.es: Es el verbo que significa «soler» y va seguido de to.

origin.text: Teenagers ___ to sleep later than adults, which is largely due to biology.

prompt.es: Ordena: «En cierta medida, las clases en línea ayudan a quienes trabajan.»

answer.text: To a certain extent online classes help students who work

feedback.es: To a certain extent abre la frase y limita el alcance de la afirmación.

hint.es: Empieza por la expresión que limita el alcance de la afirmación.

prompt.es: Escucha la clase y elige qué ventaja destaca la profesora de la segunda versión.

choices.text: It avoids mentioning the result so that nobody can object to it.
It sounds more confident and therefore easier for readers to believe.
It shows the reader how far the evidence really goes.

feedback.es: La profesora dice que la segunda versión no oculta el resultado, pero indica hasta dónde llega la prueba; no busca parecer más segura ni evitar objeciones.

origin.audio: In a short lecture on sleep, the teacher warns her students against overstating their results. A weak sentence, she says, would be: naps improve memory. A stronger one would be: the findings may indicate that short naps improve memory, at least for students under twenty. She explains that the second version does not hide the result, but it tells the reader how far the evidence goes. Then she adds that, in her experience, students tend to be too sure of their results, not too careful.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada recurso de cautela con su tipo.

pairs: Memory might improve with regular sleep.
To a certain extent, the plan works.

feedback.es: Suggest es un verbo de cautela, might es un modal, to a certain extent es una expresión y there is limited evidence señala que faltan datos.

pairs: Memory might improve with regular sleep.
To a certain extent, the plan works.

prompt.es: Lee los datos. ¿Qué versión del resultado es la más adecuada?

choices.text: There is limited evidence that most students study better in silence.
Most students study better in silence, as the survey has shown.
The survey proves that silence is the best way to study.

feedback.es: Con solo 12 estudiantes y sin más datos, lo adecuado es reconocer que la evidencia es escasa; las otras opciones presentan el resultado como un hecho probado.

origin.text: A survey of 12 students found that nine of them studied better in silence. The sample is tiny, and the survey asked nothing about age or subject.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige por qué corrige la segunda investigadora la frase.

choices.text: The online classes were too short to raise anyone's grades this year.
A small group of interested students cannot prove such a claim.
The first version was too long to fit the draft.

feedback.es: La segunda investigadora señala que la muestra era pequeña y que los alumnos que eligieron las clases en línea ya estaban más motivados: eso no permite hablar de prueba.

origin.audio: Two researchers are discussing their draft. The first says that the results prove that online classes raise grades. The second disagrees: the sample was small, and the students who chose online classes were probably more interested in studying. She suggests a more careful version: the results suggest that online classes may help interested students to a certain extent. The first researcher hesitates, then admits that the second version is more honest, although it sounds less exciting.

prompt.es: Escucha otra vez: ¿qué da a entender el primer investigador al decir «more honest»?

choices.text: That his first version had been copied from another study.
That the second version is worse because it sounds boring.
That his first version claimed more than the data allowed.

feedback.es: Llamar «more honest» a la segunda versión admite que la suya afirmaba más de lo que los datos permitían, aunque suene menos emocionante.

origin.audio: Two researchers are discussing their draft. The first says that the results prove that online classes raise grades. The second disagrees: the sample was small, and the students who chose online classes were probably more interested in studying. She suggests a more careful version: the results suggest that online classes may help interested students to a certain extent. The first researcher hesitates, then admits that the second version is more honest, although it sounds less exciting.

prompt.es: Completa: «Sería exagerar decir que las siestas mejoran la memoria de todos.»

feedback.es: Overstate the case es la colocación para afirmar más de lo que permiten los datos.

origin.text: The survey covered only forty students, so it would ___ the case to say that naps improve memory for everyone.

prompt.es: ¿Cuál es la conclusión mejor matizada para este estudio?

choices.text: The course appears to have raised scores slightly, although without a comparison group the effect is hard to measure.
The course clearly raised scores, so every school should offer it to all of its students from next year.
It could perhaps be argued that the course may possibly have raised some scores for some students.

feedback.es: Combina un verbo de cautela (appears to), un adverbio (slightly) y la limitación del diseño; la segunda exagera y la tercera apila matices sin decir nada claro.

origin.text: An article reports that a four-week course improved scores by six percent in a group of 35 students. There was no comparison group, and the students had chosen the course themselves.

prompt.es: ¿Qué actitud adoptan los autores ante su propio hallazgo?

choices.text: Confident: they believe the new timetable is the only cause.
Cautious: they accept that other factors may explain the rise.
Dismissive: they think attendance figures are not important.

feedback.es: Reconocen que la asistencia también subió en escuelas sin el nuevo horario y llaman «tentative» a su hallazgo: dejan abierta la posibilidad de otras causas.

origin.text: According to the report, the new timetable appears to have improved attendance, but the authors admit that attendance also rose in schools that kept the old timetable. They therefore describe their finding as tentative.

prompt.es: Escucha. ¿Por qué prefiere la tutora «suggest» a «prove»?

choices.text: Because the word proves is too informal for the kind of essay she marks.
Because her experiment was badly designed in the first place.
Because one experiment can show a pattern but rarely settle a question.

feedback.es: La tutora explica que un experimento, aunque esté bien diseñado, indica un patrón pero rara vez cierra una cuestión: por eso suggest es más exacto.

origin.audio: My tutor underlined the word proves in my essay and wrote beside it: the data suggest, not prove. She said that one experiment, however well designed, can indicate a pattern but can rarely settle a question. I wrote the sentence again, and it sounded less sure, yet it was more accurate.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Los resultados apuntan a que la mayoría prefiere sitios tranquilos.»

answer.text: The results suggest that most students prefer quiet places

feedback.es: Suggest that + oración completa presenta los datos como una indicación, no como una prueba.
